# milvaion Provider

Manage Milvaion scheduled jobs and read workers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    milvaion = {
      source = "milvasoft/milvaion"
    }
  }
}

# url and api_key fall back to MILVAION_URL and MILVAION_API_KEY.
provider "milvaion" {
  url = "https://milvaion.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Api key created under User Management > Api Keys. Defaults to the MILVAION_API_KEY environment variable.
- `url` (String) Milvaion address, including any base path, e.g. https://milvaion.example.com. Defaults to the MILVAION_URL environment variable.
